title: MarketObservation
description: One price snapshot of one market at one point in time. Time-series, append-only — never overwritten. This is the full-market-universe capture required by EdgeLab Phase 1 section C/D.

capturedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the raw snapshot this observation was read from

mlbGameId.description: MLB Stats API identifier when distinct from the fallback gameId

outcomeLabel.description: See Market.outcomeLabel — NOT a betting side, never YES/NO.

comparisonOperator.description: AT_LEAST (issue #43): player-prop 'N+' contracts, YES iff actual >= N -- distinct from OVER's 'actual > N.5' game-total framing.

spreadCents.description: yesAsk - yesBid in cents, a liquidity indicator

checkpoint.description: Classified distance-from-scheduled-start bucket. See lib/edgelab/checkpoints.py. INTERMEDIATE = a real recurring-poll quote that doesn't land in any target bucket; still preserved.

isClosingCandidate.description: True if this is a valid pre-suspension/pre-start tradable quote eligible to become the official closing quote

gameStartedAtCapture.description: True when capturedAt is at or after this game's scheduledStart (derived, checkpoint=='POST_START'). Null only when scheduledStart isn't known yet -- never guessed. See Market Research Corpus milestone.

isValidPregameObservation.description: True when this observation is a tradable (active/unknown status), pre-first-pitch quote -- the population eligible to anchor a manual bet's linkage or become a closing candidate. False once the game has started or the market is suspended/closed. Null only when marketStatus/scheduledStart isn't known yet.

registryClassificationStatus.description: CLASSIFIED = series is in the confirmed single-game-MLB allowlist (lib/kalshi_mlb_single_game_registry.py). UNCLASSIFIED_MLB = an MLB-prefixed (KXMLB*) series Kalshi returned that isn't yet in that allowlist and also isn't a recognized non-single-game pattern (award/futures/other-competition) -- archived here for research so a brand-new market family is never silently lost, but never fed into production selection (see lib.kalshi_mlb_single_game_registry.classify_series_for_price_check, which still excludes it there). Null only for pre-this-milestone rows written before this field existed.

githubRunId.description: GITHUB_RUN_ID of the workflow run that captured this observation, when captured in GitHub Actions. Null for a local/manual run.

commitSha.description: GITHUB_SHA of the commit checked out when this observation was captured, when known. Null when not running in GitHub Actions or not yet resolved.
